Document: # Anomalies - Anomalies, when generated, should be announced on Departmental and Common radio channels. The Anomaly Team within Epistemics (those researchers generating and maintaining anomalies) should conduct an active search throughout the station until the anomaly is located. - Anomalies that manifest in high-security or critical areas of the station should be dispersed as quickly and safely as possible. This determination is the responsibility of the ranking officer of the Department affected, or by the HOP in the case of public areas. - Once the determination to maintain an anomaly is made, a member of the Epistemics Anomaly Team must be responsible for the monitoring and maintenance of that anomaly. [bold]Any damage caused by an uncontrolled or unsupervised anomaly is the responsibility of that researcher.[/bold] If no responsible party is named, the Mystagogue assumes ultimate responsibility for the disposition of anomalies aboard the station. - "Infectious" anomalies can be kept only after Informed Consent is obtained. - Emergent anomalous entities (“anomalites”), if maintained or permitted to exist, must have a handler who is a member of the Epistemics Department. The handler of an emergent anomalous entity is responsible for the behavior of said entity, including criminal liability for any actions taken in violation of Space Law.
